scenes.say: Three eye myths you probably still believe. Let's check them.

scenes.en: Reading in dim light ruins your eyes? Fact: it only tires them.
scenes.say: Myth one. Reading in dim light damages your eyes. Fact: it makes your eyes tired, but it does not cause permanent damage. Still, use good light for comfort.

scenes.en: Carrots can remove your glasses? Fact: food supports eyes, not your power.
scenes.ta: கேரட் நல்லது, ஆனால் கண் பவரை மாற்றாது
scenes.say: Myth two. Eating carrots will remove your glasses. Fact: a healthy diet supports your eyes, but it will not change your eye power.

scenes.en: Glasses make your eyes weaker? Fact: they help you see clearly.
scenes.say: Myth three. Wearing glasses makes your eyes weaker. Fact: glasses do not weaken your eyes. They simply help you see clearly.

scenes.en: Blurry vision or eye strain? Get an eye test.
scenes.say: Blurry vision or tired eyes? Get your eyes tested by an eye specialist.
